requirement: Students practice reading words that begin or end with consonant digraphs by blending sounds together to form recognizable words. Focus: Decoding words featuring the sh, ch, th, wh, and ph consonant digraphs. Examples: ship, chop, thin, whip, phone, dash, rich, path, moth, graph. Constraints: Isolate the digraph sound at the start of words first, then advance to final position usage in the phonics-blender.
